title: Effect of tempering-induced microstructural evolution on the corrosion behaviour of high chromium cast iron
content:

This study revealed how tempering altered the microstructure of HCCI and accelerated corrosion rate in 0.5 mol dm−3 H2SO4 and 0.01 mol dm−3 HCl through galvanic effects.
